name: Asahina Kaname
source:
Birth Date: 1983/05/28.
Occupation: Monk.

Kaname is the 3rd son of the Asahina family. He’s a Buddhist monk who doesn’t act like one, and he absolutely loves hitting on every girl who walks into his field of vision. Due to his flashy appearance and attitude, he looks more like a professional host instead. Kaname is infamous for what he calls “gracious words”, and the number of women who wish to hear this suspicious subject is never-ending. He hits on [url=/c10574]Ema[/url] right from their very first encounter.

[from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/06/14/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-kaname/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
